title: Research Keywords for Campaigns with Keyword Planner – Google Ads

facts.fact: Google Ads allows multiple campaigns to be created in the same account without creating a new account.
facts.quote: You can create multiple campaigns in the same account without creating a new account.

facts.fact: The Keyword Planner page's sample screenshot shows a suggested bid of $1.72 for the keyword 'Clothing store', which is an illustrative example and not a measured market figure.
According to Google's Keyword Planner page, the tool provides suggested bid estimates for each keyword to help advertisers determine their advertising budget.
facts.quote: Keyword Planner will give you suggested bid estimates for each keyword to help you determine your advertising budget.

facts.fact: Google Keyword Planner is described by Google as a free keyword search tool that helps advertisers build keyword lists for search campaigns.
facts.quote: Google Keyword Planner is a free keyword search tool to help advertisers build keyword lists for search campaigns.

facts.fact: Anyone with a Google Ads account can access Keyword Planner after creating a campaign, and no separate Keyword Planner account needs to be created.
facts.quote: Anyone with a Google Ads account can access the Keyword Planner tool after they create a campaign. ... No separate account creation is necessary.

facts.fact: Accounts using Smart Mode must switch to Expert Mode before they can access Keyword Planner.
facts.quote: If your account is using Smart Mode, you’ll need to switch it to Expert Mode.

facts.fact: Keyword Planner's plan forecast estimates how many conversions, clicks or impressions keywords are likely to get based on the advertiser's spend.
facts.quote: Your plan forecast shows you how many conversions, clicks or impressions you’re likely to get for your keywords based on your spend.

facts.fact: Keyword Planner can be reached in Google Ads by clicking the Tools icon, selecting Planning from the section menu, then choosing Keyword Planner.
facts.quote: clicking the “Tools” icon, selecting “Planning” from the section menu, then choosing “Keyword Planner”.

facts.fact: Keyword Planner's Discover new keywords option lets advertisers start from products or services or from a website to find related keyword ideas.
facts.quote: You can start by entering keywords related to your products or services, or by entering a website to search for related content.
